name: rules-firestore-int64-and-duration-range
description: Firestore Rules Test API verdicts for corpus scenario "int64-and-duration-range" (Coverage: int64 and duration range). Integers are 64-bit: values above 2^53 keep every bit, overflow is an evaluation error except MIN / -1, unary minus applies to durations, and timestamp or duration results out of range are errors.
